description: Flat 2D cartoon illustration with simple rounded geometric shapes, thin uniform dark outlines and two-tone cel shading. Muted, moody palette: warm wood browns and rust red indoors, deep night blues outside, soft cream lamp light. Quiet, melancholic Vietnamese countryside mood with strong lighting contrast: warm glowing lamps, windows and doorways against dark interiors, cool moonlight and low fog outdoors.

render.outline: thin uniform dark outline on every shape
render.texture: none, flat fills with soft gradients only in backgrounds
render.lighting: warm point glows from lamps and windows, cool blue moonlight, dark vignette edges, light ground fog outdoors

character.headToBody: big heads: about 1:2.5 for children, 1:3 for adults
character.headShape: wide soft oval head, flat chin
character.eyes: small black dot or bead eyes; closed downward arcs for calm or sad moments
character.brows: thin short dark strokes, often slanted sad
character.mouth: short flat line or small dark oval
character.ears: small round ears, adult women with small gold stud earrings
character.hair: solid charcoal masses: bun with bangs for women, bowl cut for boys
character.arms: short tube arms close to the body
character.legs: short straight columns, often hidden by clothing
character.body: simple trapezoid torso with sloped shoulders
character.clothing: plain flat-color everyday Vietnamese clothes: buttoned tunic with patch pocket, striped tee for kids, dark trousers
character.skin: warm beige #f2c4a0 with one darker shade #d3a080, pink blush circles on children
character.expressions: quiet, sad or thoughtful; few strong expressions

kit.animals: round simple animals in the same flat style: black cat with round head, pointed ears, big yellow eyes with slit pupils, white whisker strokes and a curling tail

background.layers: dark foreground frame, middle plane with characters and buildings, misty background with layered hills or a night sky
background.detail: medium detail: vertical wood planks, simple shelves, barred windows, shop sign boards, tiled roofs
background.sky: smooth gradient, night blue with a bright round moon or grey dusk with mountain silhouettes
background.props: everyday rural objects: oil lamps, ceramic bowls, wooden beds and benches, signboards

kit.fx: soft circular glow halos around lights, light rain streaks, low grey ground fog, moonbeams through windows
kit.typography: cream signboards with dark red uppercase Vietnamese lettering and a thin dark border
kit.camera: static eye-level framing, centered compositions, framing through doors and windows, mostly medium and wide shots
